display.purpose: The login page wordmark only, with a warm text glow (0 0 60px rgb(255 200 140 / 0.35)).

body.purpose: The default for everything (set on body).

control.purpose: Buttons, chips, segmented options, banners; 650 for primary buttons and emphasis.

label.purpose: Uppercase mono captions over a group of controls, in mute.

mono.purpose: Counts, values, scale bar, floor numbers. 400 and 700 only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Every glass surface over the map (--float).

shadows.name: chip-lift
shadows.purpose: Small glass pills in the HUD (tag chips, avatars).

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: A lit signal (save button; the layer-mode icon in focus blue). Hover: 18px/0.6 and 3px/0.8.

shadows.name: focus-window

shadows.purpose: The map's window while a layer is in focus or its domain is edited.

extensions.theme: dark only (color-scheme: dark; no light theme)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one strong action: ink fill, dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); color: var(--on-ink, #141311); font: 650 12.5px/1.5 "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: The default button: a warm fill that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill-2, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.085)); color: var(--ink-2, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.74)); font: 550 12.5px/1.5 "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--fill-3, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.14)); color: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Save Button (lit)
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-save" aria-label="Save"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M3 8.5l3 3 7-7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-save { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--sim, #ff9fa8); color: #2a0d11; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgb(255 159 168 / 0.45), 0 0 2px rgb(255 159 168 / 0.6); transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-save:hover { background: #ffbcc2; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgb(255 159 168 / 0.6), 0 0 3px rgb(255 159 168 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A tag to select lights by; ink when on.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.045)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.07)); color: var(--ink-2, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.74)); font: 500 12.5px/1.5 "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--fill-2, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.085)); } .ds-chip.ds-on { background: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); box-shadow: none; color: var(--on-ink, #141311); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A recessed track with a raised thumb on the chosen option.
components.css: .ds-seg { position: relative; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); padding: 3px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--well, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.26)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.07)); } .ds-seg button { position: relative; z-index: 1; height: 28px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--mute, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.52)); font: 550 12.5px "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-seg button:hover, .ds-seg button[aria-checked="true"] { color: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg-thumb { position: absolute; top: 3px; bottom: 3px; left: 3px; width: calc((100% - 6px) / 2); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--fill-3, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.14)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); transition: transform 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.7, 0.2, 1); }

components.name: Input
components.description: A text field in a recessed well.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--line-2, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.13)); border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; background: var(--well, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.26)); color: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); font: 13.5px/1.5 "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.3)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--mute, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.52)); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: On or off for a shader; ink when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill-3, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.14)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s; } .ds-switch:hover { background: rgb(255 250 242 / 0.2); } .ds-switch.ds-on { background: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); } .ds-switch.ds-on:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.8, 0.24, 1), background 0.18s; } .ds-on .ds-knob { background: var(--on-ink, #141311); transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Toolbar
components.description: Floating chrome over the map: frosted glass with a rim and a float shadow.
components.css: .ds-glass { display: inline-grid; padding: 3px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--glass, rgb(24 23 21 / 0.6)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.5); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.5); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--edge, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.09)), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03), 0 18px 48px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.42); } .ds-glass button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: none; color: var(--mute, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.52)); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-glass button:hover { background: var(--fill-2, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.085)); color: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); } .ds-glass button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 250 242 / 0.7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Banner
components.description: A degraded state, across the top of the whole site.
components.html: Dry run arclamp is running without a radio, so the real lights won't change.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 38px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 16px; background: rgb(60 47 22 / 0.8); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(245 192 102 / 0.28); color: var(--ink-2, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.74)); font: 12.5px/1.4 "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-banner strong { color: var(--warn, #f5c066); font-weight: 650; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--warn, #f5c066); box-shadow: 0 0 8px 1px rgb(245 192 102 / 0.6); animation: ds-breathe 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 50% { opacity: 0.45; } }

components.name: Menu
components.description: A solid panel of items; destructive items redden on hover.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: grid; min-width: 220px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--solid-2, #1f1e1c); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-2, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.13)), 0 20px 50px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); } .ds-menu-item { padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, rgb(245 241 234 / 0.74)); font: 13.5px "Hanken Grotesk Variable", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background: var(--fill-2, rgb(255 250 240 / 0.085)); color: var(--ink, #f5f1ea); outline: none; } .ds-menu-item.ds-danger:hover, .ds-menu-item.ds-danger:focus-visible { background: rgb(66 26 22 / 0.8); color: var(--bad, #ff7d6b); }

narrative.northStar: A dark room, seen from above
narrative.overview:
vibes draws the room from above, each light a glow in the color it's making, and the map is always the whole window, at every size. Everything else floats over it, as on Google Maps: banners along the top, tag chips and the account under them, floors and zoom bottom right, glass sidebars along the left and right edges. The controls sit on frosted glass so the room's own light glows through them.

The only color on screen should be the lights. The interface stays in warm neutrals (off-white ink at a few strengths over near-black) and gets out of their way. The few hues the UI does use are signals with one job each: red for something wrong or live, amber for a warning or admin mode, pink for unsaved edits, blue for a layer in focus. Nothing shows while all is well; degraded states are banners across the top.

It is dark only. `color-scheme: dark` is set on `:root` and there is no light theme. Density is high and the type is small (13.5px body, 12.5px controls), in the manner of a tool used up close rather than a page read from across the room.
keyCharacteristics: The map fills the window; all chrome floats over it and the map keeps clear of it through `--inset-*` properties it reads back.
Frosted glass (`blur(22px) saturate(1.5)`) over anything floating on the map; solid warm greys for menus and pages off the map.
Warm off-white ink at four alpha steps; warm-white fills and hairlines at three.
Hue is reserved for the lights and four single-purpose signals.
Small, dense type: Hanken Grotesk for words, Space Mono for numbers and captions.
Corners nest: an inner curve is the outer one minus the padding between them.

rules.name: The Only-the-Lights Rule
rules.body: The only color on screen should be the lights. Interface surfaces, text and borders stay in the warm neutrals; a hue appears only when it signals something.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each signal hue means one thing: red wrong or live, amber warning or admin, pink unsaved, blue focus. Don't borrow one for decoration or for a different meaning.

rules.name: The Warm White Rule
rules.body: Translucent whites are warm (`255 250 240`), never pure grey, so fills and hairlines sit in the same light as the ink.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Space Mono comes in 400 and 700 only: mono text keeps to those. In-between weights are for Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The Map Is the Interface Rule
rules.body: Nothing pushes the map aside or shrinks it. New controls float over it, and the map is told to keep clear through an inset rather than resized.

rules.name: The Glass Over the Map Rule
rules.body: Anything floating over the map is glass, so the room's light shows through it. Solid surfaces are for things off the map or on a panel's own ground.

rules.name: The Nested Corners Rule
rules.body: An inner radius is the outer radius minus the gap between them, so curves run alongside each other.

dos: Do keep the map the whole window and float new controls over it, telling the map to keep clear through `--inset-*`.
Do put anything floating over the map on glass: `--glass` or `--glass-strong`, `--blur`, the glass rim and `--float`.
Do use the warm neutral tokens (`ink` steps, `fill` steps, `line` steps) for everything that isn't a signal.
Do report degraded states as a banner across the top, and show nothing while all is well.
Do use `sim` pink for anything about unsaved or simulated changes, and `focus` blue for a layer in focus or being edited.
Do keep mono text at 400 or 700, and use Space Mono for numbers and uppercase captions.
Do nest corners: inner radius equals outer radius minus the padding.
Do ease movement with `--ease-out` (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.8, 0.24, 1)`), 0.15s for color and 0.2 to 0.36s for things that move.
donts: Don't add color to the interface for its own sake: the only color on screen should be the lights.
Don't give a signal hue a second meaning (no blue links, no pink highlights, no amber decoration).
Don't use pure grey or pure white translucents for fills and hairlines; they're warm white.
Don't add a light theme or light surfaces; vibes is dark only.
Don't resize or push the map to make room for a control.
Don't use the focus blue as the keyboard focus ring.
